# Craft Skill @ Stage 10 — Concrete Peak

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 10 |
| Canonical name | Concrete Peak |
| Altitude | `amber` (Ethnocentric) |

| Kegan | 3 |
| Identity band | Ethnocentric |

## Expression on this line

Craft skill at Order 9 is complex craft integration: the craftsperson coordinates multiple
technique frameworks (traditional handcraft, digital fabrication, material science, design
thinking) into a coherent whole. The advance over Stage 9 is that craft skill is no longer
just systematic but complex: multiple technique dimensions are held in productive tension
within one coherent craft practice.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt richness of a multi-dimensional craft practice.
- **UR:** reliable integration of multiple technique frameworks into coherent craft production.
- **LL:** a craft culture that values integration — communities that support multiple
  technique dimensions simultaneously.
- **LR:** the institutional structures that provide platforms for integrated craft practice.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction holding so many technique frameworks that no
  coherent craft emerges.
- **Dark allergy:** integration failure — the craftsperson cannot integrate multiple technique
  dimensions.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved complex craft mastery (Stage 11) while
  actually just integrating multiple technique frameworks.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with craft integration because it dilutes purity of
  tradition.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Multi-framework craft:** the craftsperson integrates multiple technique frameworks into
  one coherent practice.
- **Cross-traditional craft fluency:** the craftsperson demonstrates competence across
  multiple craft traditions.
- **Integrated craft practice:** multiple technique dimensions are held in productive tension.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Crawford, *Shop Class as Soulcraft* (integrative craft practice); Dreyfus &
Dreyfus, *Mind over Machine* (expert craft as complex integration).
**Open joints:** How does complex craft integration shade into craft mastery (Stage 11)?

(craft mastery).
